newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton output reaches 7.867 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton output reaches 7.867 mln bales.

text.p: Pakistan's cotton production had reached 7.867 million 375-lb bales in the 1996/97 (July/June) crop year by January 15, down from 8.288 million bales at the same date last year, ginners said on Sunday.

The private Pakistan Cotton Ginners Association said spinning mills had bought 5.979 million bales against 5.86 million bales last year, but exporters had bought only 4,700 bales, compared to 767,559 bales last year.

The association said ginneries had unsold stocks of 1.409 million bales and 473,180 un-ginned press bales were in stock with them on January 15, compared to total stocks of 1.66 million bales in the same period last year.
